fewShots.question: Wie viele Kernaussagen gibt es und wie genau sitzen die Sprungmarken?
fewShots.query: SELECT [precision], COUNT(*) AS anzahl FROM n_claim GROUP BY [precision];

fewShots.question: Was wurde zu Direct Lake gesagt?
fewShots.query: SELECT TOP 20 d.title AS folge, d.published AS datum, k.[text] AS aussage, k.kind AS art, CAST(ROUND(k.start_s, 0) AS int) AS sekunde, k.[precision] AS genauigkeit, d.url + '&t=' + CAST(CAST(ROUND(k.start_s, 0) AS int) AS varchar(10)) + 's' AS sprungmarke FROM e_about a JOIN n_claim k ON k.id = a.src JOIN n_document d ON d.id = k.doc_id WHERE a.dst = 'tool:direct-lake' ORDER BY d.published DESC;

fewShots.question: Welche Folgen behandeln das Sternschema am ausfuehrlichsten?
fewShots.query: SELECT TOP 10 d.title AS folge, d.published AS datum, m.segments AS stellen, m.share AS anteil FROM e_mentions m JOIN n_document d ON d.id = m.src WHERE m.dst = 'topic:sternschema' ORDER BY m.segments * (0.3 + m.share) DESC;

fewShots.question: Wer spricht in den meisten Folgen mit?
fewShots.query: SELECT p.name AS person, COUNT(*) AS folgen, SUM(CASE WHEN s.role = 'host' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS als_host FROM e_speaks_in s JOIN n_person p ON p.id = s.src GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY folgen DESC;

fewShots.question: In welchen Folgen faellt das Wort Data Vault woertlich?
fewShots.query: SELECT TOP 20 d.title AS folge, d.published AS datum, CAST(ROUND(s.start_s, 0) AS int) AS sekunde, s.[text] AS stelle FROM segments s JOIN n_document d ON d.id = s.doc_id WHERE s.[text] LIKE '%Data Vault%' ORDER BY d.published DESC;

fewShots.question: Welche Themen haben viele Dokumente, aber keine Kernaussagen?
fewShots.query: SELECT TOP 20 c.name AS thema, c.doc_count AS dokumente FROM n_concept c LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT dst FROM e_about) a ON a.dst = c.id WHERE a.dst IS NULL ORDER BY c.doc_count DESC;

fewShots.question: Welche Folgen sind die neuesten mit Kernaussagen?
fewShots.query: SELECT TOP 10 title AS folge, published AS datum, n_claims AS kernaussagen, url FROM n_document WHERE source = 'youtube' AND n_claims > 0 ORDER BY published DESC;

fewShots.question: Was steckt hinter der Abkuerzung RLS?
fewShots.query: SELECT id, name, kind, aliases, doc_count FROM n_concept WHERE aliases LIKE '%RLS%' OR name LIKE '%RLS%';
